{{Quote|A Force technique, it is. The body functions of targets, it rapidly slows. Most effective for subduing opponents this is. Yet dangerous, too. Constantly monitored, a target must be. Fail to reverse the process should the Jedi, indefinite the unconsciousness can be. Die of dehydration or starvation, can an untended target. Realized this, the ancient Jedi did. Much research into history have I done. Known to use this technique dark side Force-users are not. Not malevolent is Morichro. To master Morichro, less malevolent uses of the Force must a student master first.|Yaddle|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force" />}}
'''''Morichro''''' was a powerful, but potentially dangerous [[Force power/Legends|technique]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] which could slow down the body functions of oneself or another being into mild catatonia or long-term suspended animation or even to extinguish life. Although a few [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] practiced this as "forbidden" classified ability, it was considered off-limits for [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] without exceptions. One of its chief practitioners in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order's]] last years was Jedi Master [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]].

==Description==
{{Quote|He's in some kind of Jedi trance.''"<br />"''He slowed his functions almost to the point of suspended animation.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] about [[Kyp Durron]]|<ref name="Champions of the Force" />}}
Similar to a [[Hibernation trance/Legends|Force trance]], ''morichro'' suspended biological functions, including breathing and heart rate. A trained ''morichro'' user could turn the technique upon himself, surviving without food, water, or even air for periods of over a year at a time, though it would not protect against [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]]. But unlike a Force trance, it could also be turned on others, making it an effective way of subduing enemies. However, failure to monitor a targeted opponent could render them permanently unconscious or cause them to die of dehydration or starvation.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force" /> There was a great risk that an untrained user may go too far and accidentally stop a [[Heart/Legends|heart]] from beating.<ref name="Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

==History and notable users==
{{Quote|I felt my legs topple, my heart grow heavy and strain, my lungs flutter and struggle.|Arden Lyn|<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Arden_Lyn_JTL.png|thumb||left|250px|Arden Lyn, who slept for 24,496 years as result of being subject to ''morichro''.]]
''Morichro'' was known to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as early as [[24,500 BBY]]. During the [[First Great Schism]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Awdrysta Pina]] used the technique against [[Arden Lyn]], stopping her heart<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force" /> until the power of the [[Kashi Mer talisman]] resurrected her<ref name="tep">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref> in [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Before approximately [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], use and training in ''morichro'' was left unchecked, but the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Council]]&mdash;wary of its potential for abuse&mdash;classified it as forbidden ability and banned its teachings to all but a select few by [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="potj" />

[[File:Yaddle_in_chair.jpg|thumb||right|250px|Jedi Master Yaddle, a famous practitioner of ''morichro'']]
Before long, the Force ability became forgotten to most Jedi, and its mention became scarce, if hardly at all. In the last centuries of the old Jedi Order, however, the Jedi Master [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]] uncovered the ancient technique after apparently scanning through three [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] that barely contained any information on the power. While the Jedi High Council allowed her to teach some students on ''morichro'', they ultimately prohibited its use as abuse of the technique could easily prove fatal.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healers]] used ''morichro'' to destroy [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mites]] on [[Kishi]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

[[Kyp Durron]] used ''morichro'' when he saved himself from the destruction of the [[Sun Crusher]]. After stuffing himself inside a messenger pod as his only means of escape, he was rescued by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]. Han thought that Kyp entered into a form of Jedi [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]], but Mara corrected him saying that Kyp survived by slowing his bodily functions to the point of near-stasis.<ref name="Champions of the Force" />

[[Anakin Solo]]  used ''morichro'' to kill a [[reel]] on [[Yavin 8/Legends|Yavin 8]].<ref name="Junior Jedi Knights: Lyric's World" />

==Behind the scenes==
When first named in "[[The Emperor's Pawns]]" article, this ability was spelled "mortichro." ''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]'' misspelled it as "morichro," and that became the accepted spelling in subsequent sources.

[[Daniel Wallace]] came up with the name "mortichro" for ''[[The Essential Guide to Episode I]]'', but ''The Essential Guide to Episode I'' was cancelled, so the name was first mentioned in "The Emperor's Pawns".<ref name="EPendnotes">{{Blog|abelgpena|84|The Emperor's Pawns Endnotes, Part 4: Mistress of Teräs Käsi}}</ref>
